text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I see Admire Vega and Silence
Suzuka
running together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you training with someone.
It's rare to see you training with someone, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'm not training with her...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Our schedules just happened to overlap.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, our training times
often
overlap, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We usually end at the same time as well.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After which we naturally split our tasks
and tidy
up together...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The places where we train solo outside
the
academy are also the same.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and we both usually increase our
pace in
sessions leading up to a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them seem to have a similar
mindset
when it comes to training...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well... I wouldn't mind that. But how
about
you, Ayabe?
choice_data_list: Why don't the two of you train together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If it helps us get faster, let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay... so how should we go about it?
Should we
just run like usual?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: For starters, what is your usual anyway?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh right... Sorry. Um... What should I
say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two begin their training.
However...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(I should adjust my pace since we're
running
together.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Weird... this doesn't really feel
motivating.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears they're having trouble
synchronizing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Shall we call it about enough for today?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, I see Admire Vega
and Silence
Suzuka running together
down the track again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both look remarkable, maintaining
their
distance, position, and speed while
not
interfering with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both continue forward, as if
completely
unaware of each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's what works better for
them.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm not so sure about that...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But... I do find it really easy to run with
Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the situation, I can just keep
running in
silence.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels... comfortable. Like, I can just be
myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I get that too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I get that too.
choice_data_list: Maybe there's something fateful about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't be so dramatic.
choice_data_list: Maybe there's something fateful about it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Although, I'd be lying if I said I didn't
feel
anything.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(I know I've felt something, even before
now.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (But it's a bit late to mention it...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmm, we get along, but are we friends?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Stuff like that doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All that matters to me is being able to
run
comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Same here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them may not be able to put
a name
to their relationship, but it's
clear that they share
a special bond.
